summary: François Picard is pleased to welcome Andrew Weissmann, Professor of Practice at NYU School of Law and a former federal prosecutor known for leading major Department of Justice (DOJ) and FBI investigations. summary: Haitians are hailing the Bukele method. Citizens of the Americas' poorest nation are cheering the Salvadoran president’s "shoot first, ask questions later" method of dealing with the gangs that have overrun their country for the past six years. Can the police force deployed actually restore law and order? We ask about the latest in a decades-long list of efforts by the international community to support Haiti.

title: Car bomb destroys buildings in central Colombian city

title: Colombia president says 'all hostages rescued' from supermarket siege

title: Democrats vow probe after Trump presses Huang's return as Nvidia CEO

title: Israeli army launches ground operation in Hamas-controlled area of Gaza

summary: Photographs published by Iranian local media suggest that US forces may have used graphite bombs, also known as ‘blackout bombs’, against infrastructure in Iran in recent days.
